meta.title: fix: parallelize Google Calendar API calls
meta.body_summary: Fix Google Calendar availability latency by running API calls concurrently with Promise.all instead of sequentially.

core_change_summary.description: In CalendarService.ts, Google Calendar API calls in getAvailability and fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache were refactored to use Promise.all for concurrent execution instead of sequential awaits.
change_trajectory: Single commit replaced sequential await loops with Promise.all for date ranges and event types.
